independence.scope: Independent visual observations of the protocol's 13 anonymous report-native JPEGs only; fresh agent context limited to repository controls, the evidence-falsification-auditor skill, this protocol, safe provenance metadata and source images.
independence.prior_material_seen: No prior or current appearance annotations, source page renders, figure/caption associations, source prose, model inputs or other reviewer results were opened before freezing. The provenance key was programmatically projected only to asset_id and extracted_view.sha256, dimensions and path; the projection included metadata-only entries outside this batch, whose images were not inspected.
independence.controls: Six disclosed text-scenario answers were saved in reviewer-controls.json before any batch image was opened. These are rule-comprehension controls, not tests of visual detection.
independence.limits: Visible source-added numerals, arrows and credits, report selection, task context and general knowledge compromise blindness. This is an AI review, not a qualified human forensic examination. Candidate frontage is not independently authenticated building identity.
independence.method: Each complete JPEG was opened through view_image with detail original, in the protocol order. No crop, enhancement, resampling, pixel generation, automatic flame classifier or contact-sheet-only review was used. Coordinates are approximate locators, not segmentations or area/count measurements.
